name: smwmusic-revelations-the-demon-slayer-dungeon-last-bible-iii-remix
title: Revelations: The Demon Slayer - Dungeon (Last Bible III Remix)
description:
Last Bible’s Dungeon theme, remastered using Last Bible III’s samples. This remix actually won the 11th 120hoSPC contest too, so that’s neat!

I really enjoy taking these old tracks and giving them a new coat of paint. The first Last Bible doesn’t have as many quality tunes as the second one, but this in particular is one of the best from both games, so I had to do it justice. Shoutouts to all the chorded samples Last Bible III has.

NOTE: If you don't have both left and right audio coming out (i.e. a single earbud connected or something) you might not hear the bass due to it using surround sound. Thought I would make note of that in case someone runs into that like I did.
